title: Validate current operational candidates without inventing decisions
statement: The system shall validate complete current operational candidates against the selected supported contract and preservation rules, resolving typed references while separating structural validity from engineering judgment.

what.problem: A superficially valid update can contain ambiguous references, mixed formats, rewritten concern history, or inferred approval and applicability.
what.desired_outcome: Only structurally admissible, explicitly authored record candidates proceed, and correction remains possible when substantive work is incomplete or observations contradict a recorded claim.

why.rationale: Preserving both record meaning and the ability to report problems prevents mechanical validation from fabricating authority or blocking necessary correction.

stakeholders: Engineers and reviewers operating on recorded engineering work
Engineering agents acting on explicit actor decisions
Maintainers and consumers of the published command-line interface

conditions: When previewing or publishing an ordinary task candidate, or validating a staged maintenance candidate.

contexts: The complete candidate for one selected project Change and its supporting records, with prior state for preservation checks.

how.approach: Validate closed types before dependent reference and preservation rules. Preserve undispositioned issues and assessor attribution; typed support checks expose reliance gaps without authenticating judgments.

how_much.scope: Supported operational record shapes, identities, applicability, reference namespaces and preservation rules. Storage registration is tool-owned; a physical path or schema version alone grants no authority. Retired history remains archival unless explicitly supported for migration under SR-077; REM engineering entity conformance is a separate responsibility.

acceptance_criteria: Unknown fields or vocabularies, duplicate keys or identities, missing required values, unsupported encodings/versions, mixed stores, dual report representations, and malformed current records reject before authoritative writes.

Every supporting record has an unambiguous identity, owning Change and kind, with explicit applicability wherever the selected contract requires a reliance decision. References resolve exactly one admissible object in the complete candidate; storage-layout adjacency grants no authority and cross-Change fallback cannot repair an unresolved reference.

Supplied scope, subjects, narrative, provenance and decisions are preserved. Adverse evidence and explicit invalidation remain recordable; new success claims must meet the selected contract’s current support requirements.

Omitted issues remain unchanged, and open findings/blockers require explicit attributable disposition. The selected v4 contract permits later compaction and current-assessment replacement without permanent history; v3 retains its finding and immutable-origin rules. Validation must not infer resolution or reviewer judgment.

Reviews and Verifications use distinct closed assessment shapes with explicit scope, governing basis, support and limitations. Final successful Verify requires applicable mandatory review and accepted bases; scoped adverse results can be recorded without inventing missing success prerequisites.
constraints: Current allocations describe v4 SQLite; historical contribution arguments retain their original criterion subjects and do not prove current satisfaction.
